يبتنون (form VIII)
# يَبْتَنُونَ (yabtanūna) /jab.ta.nuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
# يُبْتَنَوْنَ (yubtanawna) /jub.ta.naw.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَنَى (ibtanā)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
